title: Freemax Fireluke X3 Mesh 0.15
description: The immaculately-crafted X3 triple mesh sub ohm coils from Freemax are designed for use with the Freemax Fireluke tank series and are rated at 0.15ohm for sumptuous, satisfying vaping between 50 and 90 watts. The Freemax Fireluke X3 coils are wicked with a unique blend of 90% flax cotton and 10% standard organic cotton for intense, rich flavour which maintains its freshness far longer than standard cotton blend coils.
